title: Coresets for Density-Based Clustering via Bayesian Predictive Partition Matching
abstract: arXiv:2502.05725v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Density-based clustering identifies groups as connected high-density regions, accommodating irregular shapes and reflecting their geometry, but this reliance on density estimation introduces uncertainty into the resulting partitions, which is often costly to quantify. To represent this uncertainty efficiently, we construct a compact representation of the data, or coreset, designed to preserve the distribution of predictive density-based partitions. We sample observations from a Dirichlet process surrogate, smooth them to estimate densities, and use the resulting level sets to partition a common reference set. Starting from a uniform subsample, we learn an affine transformation that improves agreement with full-data partitions by minimizing a tractable approximation to paired expected variation of information. translated_title: 基于贝叶斯预测分区匹配的密度聚类核心集
translated_abstract: 基于密度的聚类将数据组识别为连通的高密度区域，能够适应不规则形状并反映其几何特性，但这种对密度估计的依赖性会给最终的分区结果引入不确定性，而量化这种不确定性通常代价高昂。为了高效地表示这种不确定性，我们构建了一种紧凑的数据表示（即核心集/coreset），旨在保留基于密度的预测分区的分布。我们从狄利克雷过程代理模型中采样观测点，对其进行平滑处理以估计密度，并利用所得的水平集对公共参考集进行分区。从均匀子样本出发，我们通过最小化成对期望变异信息的一个可处理的近似，学习一个仿射变换，以改善与全数据分区的一致性。随后，全新的独立预测模拟引导最终变换的选择。我们的分析提供了……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于贝叶斯预测分区匹配的核心集构建方法，通过狄利克雷过程代理采样、密度水平集分区以及学习仿射变换来最小化与全数据分区的变异信息，从而以紧凑的数据表示高效保留密度聚类分区的预测不确定性分布。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a coreset construction method via Bayesian predictive partition matching, which samples from a Dirichlet process surrogate, partitions a reference set using density level sets, and learns an affine transformation by minimizing a tractable approximation of variation of information, thereby efficiently preserving the predictive distribution of density-based clustering partitions in a compact data representation.
